description: This PHP script manages the display and interaction with test plans in the TestLink project management system. It initializes the page, loads test plan data, manages custom fields, handles user permissions, and renders the output via Smarty templates.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data and operations.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class managing test plan data and operations.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty template engine class used for rendering.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns arguments object with test project ID, name, and current user.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with test project info, user rights, and editor configuration.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to create test plans for the specified test project.
